key_impacts: Overwhelming quantities of debris were left by the earthquake.
Some buildings remained standing but were rendered uninhabitable and required safe demolition to avoid danger to the community.
Private and government structures were terminally damaged, and rubble clearing was needed to facilitate reconstruction.
Damaged public and private buildings required structural assessment.

key_impacts: A 7.8-magnitude earthquake struck the Pacific Coast of Ecuador on 16 April 2016.
UNV established an Ecuador Earthquake Taskforce to coordinate recovery on the ground.
Fifty national and international UN Volunteers were deployed as frontline responders.
Response activities included monitoring and evaluation of shelters and support in communications, architecture, health and reporting.
